claims.claim: XLNet permutation LM factorizes over permuted original positions while retaining original positional information.
claims.verification_note: Permutation changes factorization order, not token order of sentence.

claims.claim: Two-stream attention separates content representations from target-aware query states, preventing trivial target-token leakage.
claims.verification_note: Query stream excludes current target token content; content stream includes own content.

claims.claim: XLNet uses partial prediction to reduce optimization cost instead of predicting every position for each sampled permutation.
claims.verification_note: Equation is presented as conceptual full-factorization, not exact implementation loss positions.

claims.claim: XLNet combines permutation LM with Transformer-XL segment recurrence and relative position encoding.
claims.verification_note: Separate long-context architectural ideas from permutation objective.

claims.claim: Transformer-XL segment-level recurrence reuses hidden states from prior segments.
claims.verification_note: Memory semantics are distinct from XLNet permutation semantics.

claims.claim: XLNet official code provides sequence permutation and preprocessing details.
claims.verification_note: Original repository, cross-checked with model-paper factorization explanation.
